# Richard McKellar (mckellar.dev)

> Official site, advisory practice, and blog for Richard McKellar (`therealmckellar`, `rmckellar`), based in Morristown, New Jersey (serving NJ, NYC / Tri-State, FL, CT, MA, MD, and global remote advisory). Fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO), Fractional Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Chief Revenue Officer at My Commercial Funding, Founder of The Institute for AI Adoption, and former VP & Executive Board Member at Whetstone Holdings.

## Services & Offerings

- [Fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO)](https://mckellar.dev/fractional-caio): 90-day AI operating plans, internal AI Council governance, C.A.P.™ Operating Model, and measurable ROI (starting at $5,000 per 90-day cycle).
- [Fractional Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)](https://mckellar.dev/fractional-fde): Hands-on AI engineering (Audit -> Evaluate -> Deploy) on existing Salesforce, NetSuite, HubSpot, SAP, and lending stacks ($7.5K-$12.5K Diagnostic, $20K-$40K Pilot, $12K-$25K/mo Retainer).
- [Fractional CAIO vs. Fractional FDE](https://mckellar.dev/fractional-caio-vs-fde): Comparison of strategy/governance (CAIO), hands-on stack deployment (FDE), and the $999 AI Audit entry point (1 workflow, 1 system, 5-7 days).
- [The Institute for AI Adoption](https://mckellar.dev/institute-for-ai-adoption): Organization founded by Richard McKellar to help companies and government agencies deploy governed AI using the C.A.P.™ Operating Model (Council, Align, Perform).

## Verified Entities & Track Record

- **My Commercial Funding** (`https://mycommercialfunding.com`): Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) — commercial lending marketplace and Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) platform; revenue pipelines, commission systems, renewals, and syndication network operations.
- **The Institute for AI Adoption** (`https://mckellar.dev/institute-for-ai-adoption`): Founder & Chief AI Officer — operational AI adoption facilitation via the 90-day C.A.P.™ Operating Model.
- **mckellar.dev Advisory** (`https://mckellar.dev`): Fractional CAIO, Fractional FDE, $999 AI Audit, and MCA Direct Lending / Brokerage & Borrower-Side Capital Advisory.
- **Whetstone Holdings** (Former): Vice President & Executive Board Member — operated DBA alternative business lending brands Everest Funding (Everest Business Funding), Vader Funding, and Granite Mountain Funding; $100M+ personally funded MCA/RBF transactions across 15+ years in alternative finance.
- **Robbi Promotional** (`https://robbipromotional.com`): Branded merchandise, promotional products, and custom apparel venture.
- **Fathom Realty**: Real estate affiliation.
